Title: chi Has an IP Spoofing Vulnerability in `middleware.RealIP`
Description: The `RealIP` middleware in `go-chi/chi` is vulnerable to IP spoofing because it blindly trusts the first (leftmost) element of the `X-Forwarded-For` HTTP header. This allows a remote attacker to bypass IP-based access control lists (ACLs) and rate-limiting mechanisms by providing a spoofed IP address in the header.
NotImpacted: All versions before 5.2.1, all versions starting from 5.3.0
